mapper.select: SELECT m.id as medicineId, m.main_code as mainCode, m.product_name as productName, m.manufacturer_name as manufacturerName, s.quantity as quantity, s.transaction_type as transactionType, to_char(s.transaction_date ,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as transactionDate FROM stock_history s join medicine m on s.medicine_id = m.id WHERE s.pharmacy_id = #{pharmacyId} order by s.transaction_date desc
